name: @cc/dsh-run-code-projection
description: Bounds a large tool result in the model context: on tools/post-execute a result of a configured tool (run_code, bash, read, web_fetch, hindsight pages, task_list, ...) above minBytes is replaced by a banner naming a spill file inside the session workspace plus its head and tail, so the full text stays readable with the ordinary file tools while the middle stops being re-sent every step. Errors, short results, images, contract tools and already-projected content pass through untouched.
